faq_q1: What types of cases does your firm handle?
faq_a1: We are a full-service law firm. Our expertise spans across Civil Litigation, Criminal Defense, Corporate Law, Family Law (including Divorce and Inheritance), Land Disputes, and Writ Petitions in the Supreme Court of Bangladesh.
faq_q2: How do I book a consultation with a lawyer?
faq_a2: You can book an appointment by calling our office directly at +880 1711 602 369, emailing us at adv.prince.islam@gmail.com, or filling out the contact form on our website. We offer both in-person meetings at our chambers and virtual consultations via Zoom/WhatsApp.
faq_q3: What should I bring to my first meeting?
faq_a3: To provide the best advice, please bring all relevant documents, including:
faq_b2: Copies of any existing court orders or summons.
faq_b3: Relevant contracts, land deeds (Khatiyan/Dalil), or police reports (FIR/GD).
faq_b4: Any other documents that may be relevant to your case.
faq_q4: How are legal fees determined in Bangladesh?
faq_a4: Fees vary based on the complexity of the case and the level of the court (e.g., Assistant Judge Court vs. High Court Division).

about_content_text: Established in 2014 by Advocate Md. Shamiul Islam, This Law Chamber has swiftly emerged as one of the top law firms in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Over the years, our chamber has garnered a strong reputation as a premier full-service law firm for its exceptional legal counselling, documentation and representation in and out of the Courtroom. Our team of highly skilled and dedicated lawyers, including company lawyers, corporate lawyers, civil lawyers, and criminal defence lawyers, are renowned for their unwavering determination, hard work, and consistent delivery of the best legal aid to businesses and individuals within and beyond the borders of Bangladesh.
